label: DoorDash Reviews API
title: DoorDash Reviews API: Ratings, Text & Ordered Items
metaDescription: Get customer reviews from any DoorDash store: star rating, review text, reviewer, ordered items with prices, votes and photo attachments.
intro: Paste DoorDash store links and get customer reviews: star rating, review text, reviewer profile, ordered items with prices, vote ratings and photo attachments, as JSON or CSV, also through the Apify API.
useCases: Find the dishes customers mention most
Track review trends after a menu change

faq.q: Is there a DoorDash reviews API?
faq.a: Not a public one: DoorDash's APIs serve merchants and delivery partners, not review data. This actor works like a DoorDash reviews API: send store links, get every review as JSON.
Star rating, review text, date, verified-order flag, helpful votes, the items the customer ordered and any photos. Reviewer names can be left out of your export.

faq.q: Can I use it as a DoorDash reviews API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: DoorDash's APIs (Drive, Marketplace) are for merchants and delivery partners and do not return public store reviews. This actor reads the reviews shown on DoorDash store pages.
